Method of Attack: IoT worm malware that spreads by launching brute-force attacks on Telnet port using default admin credentials

Exploits vulnerabilities such as non-standard Telnet ports, remote shells with default or blank credentials, buffer overflow bugs in DVR firmware, and directory traversal bugs to maintain persistence and reinfect devices
Can survive device reboots to create permanent infections
Impacted Systems: Devices vulnerable to Telnet brute-force attacks
DVRs with buffer overflow and directory traversal vulnerabilities
Attack Vector: Brute-force attacks on Telnet port 23 and non-standard Telnet port 12323 using default credentials
Remote shell access via port 9527 with default credentials
Exploitation of buffer overflow via port 80 (DVR web server)
Directory traversal attacks to recover password hashes
